title: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics reveal glycolytic remodeling and ENO1-associated metabolic vulnerability in hepatoblastoma.
authors: Wu, Xiongwei; Zhou, Pingping; Wu, Siyan; Zhang, Zhengshou; Jian, Xuemin
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用单细胞和空间转录组学分析肝母细胞瘤的糖酵解重编程，虽涉及转录因子活性分析，但核心是代谢异质性而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法以转录组分析为主，仅分子对接和MD模拟用于化合物验证，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatoblastoma (HB) is the most common malignant liver tumor in children; however, the contribution of glycolytic metabolic reprogramming to HB development and progression remains incompletely characterized. METHODS: We integrated single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomic datasets of HB from the GEO database. Glycometabolic pathway activity was quantified using scMetabolism, and pseudotime and transcription factor activity analyses were performed to characterize regulatory programs associated with glycolytic reprogramming. CellChat and spatial transcriptomics were applied to examine predicted tumor-immune communication. hdWGCNA combined with differential expression analysis was used to prioritize glycolysis-associated genes. ENO1 was further evaluated by in silico network perturbation, two independent shRNAs in vitro, and computational compound prioritization followed by molecular docking and a 100-ns molecular dynamics simulation. RESULTS: The single-cell atlas resolved 10 major cell types and revealed elevated glycolysis/gluconeogenesis pathway scores in malignant epithelial cells. Pseudotime analysis showed increasing glycolytic activity along the inferred epithelial trajectory. CellChat predicted enhanced MDK-NCL communication between Glyco_High tumor cells and neutrophils, while spatial analysis showed regional concordance between MDK/NCL co-expression and high-glycolysis areas. hdWGCNA identified three glycolysis-associated candidate genes: ENO1, AKR1A1, and AHCY. In silico ENO1 perturbation was associated with altered inferred regulatory activity of approximately 2.1% of genes. Two independent ENO1-targeting shRNAs produced concordant reductions in proliferation, colony formation, lactate production, and glucose consumption in HepG2 and Huh6 cells. BRD-K14653796 was computationally prioritized, and the modeled ENO1-compound complex remained conformationally stable under the specified simulation conditions. CONCLUSIONS: This study characterizes glycolytic heterogeneity in HB at single-cell and spatial resolution and nominates ENO1 as a candidate metabolic vulnerability in CNV-high putative malignant epithelial cells. It also highlights a computationally predicted MDK-NCL-associated tumor-immune communication pattern and provides testable hypotheses for future preclinical validation.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝母细胞瘤（Hepatoblastoma, HB）是儿童中最常见的恶性肝脏肿瘤；然而，糖酵解代谢重编程对HB发生和进展的贡献尚未被完全阐明。方法：我们整合了来自GEO数据库中HB的单细胞RNA测序和空间转录组数据集。使用scMetabolism量化糖代谢通路活性，并进行伪时间分析和转录因子活性分析，以表征与糖酵解重编程相关的调控程序。应用CellChat和空间转录组学检查预测的肿瘤-免疫通讯。使用hdWGCNA结合差异表达分析优先排序糖酵解相关基因。ENO1通过计算机模拟网络扰动、两种独立shRNA体外实验以及计算化合物优先级排序后进行分子对接和100纳秒分子动力学模拟进一步评估。结果：单细胞图谱解析出10种主要细胞类型，并显示恶性上皮细胞中糖酵解/糖异生通路评分升高。伪时间分析显示沿推断的上皮轨迹糖酵解活性增加。CellChat预测了Glyco_High肿瘤细胞与中性粒细胞之间增强的MDK-NCL通讯，而空间分析显示MDK/NCL共表达与高糖酵解区域之间存在区域一致性。hdWGCNA识别出三个糖酵解相关候选基因：ENO1、AKR1A1和AHCY。计算机模拟ENO1扰动与约2.1%基因的推断调控活性改变相关。两种独立的ENO1靶向shRNA在HepG2和Huh6细胞中产生一致的增殖、集落形成、乳酸产生和葡萄糖消耗减少。BRD-K14653796被计算优先级排序，模拟的ENO1-化合物复合物在指定模拟条件下保持构象稳定。结论：本研究在单细胞和空间分辨率下表征了HB中的糖酵解异质性，并将ENO1提名为CNV高推定恶性上皮细胞中的候选代谢脆弱点。它还突出了一个计算预测的MDK-NCL相关肿瘤-免疫通讯模式，并为未来临床前验证提供了可测试的假设。
